digest.component_or_area: reconciler field-contract registry and property tests
propositions: Asymmetric field-handling policy is scattered across multiple reconciler call sites without a single declarative source, causing parity bugs to escape detection.
A field-contract registry must enumerate each reconciled field with its symmetry class (bidirectional-roundtrip, add-wins, or one-way-with-propagation-gate) and reference its codec/gate.
Property tests parameterized off the registry must assert behavior matches declarations: roundtrip identity for bidirectional, merge-idempotence for add-wins, and gate-consultation for gated fields.
A coverage guard must fail test collection if any field handled by inbound_differ/apply_inbound_records lacks a registry entry, preventing undeclared fields from shipping.
The registration contract and call-site rewiring are distinct; this ticket declares and tests code behavior matching declarations without refactoring call sites.
